commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-ipo-tests2.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED="977c48d221cd310be70f39653a33d8eb4abd5ebd"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "SOURCE_SHA|$EXPECTED"
make test-ipo
echo "IPO_CPP_B5_AND_ACTIVATION|PASS"
if command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 if ! test -x web/node_modules/.bin/vitest; then
   pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline --ignore-scripts || echo "IPO_VITEST_INSTALL|BLOCKED"
 fi
 if test -x web/node_modules/.bin/vitest; then
   pnpm --dir web exec vitest run src/domain/ipo-board-readiness.test.ts
   echo "IPO_VITEST_B5|PASS"
 else
   echo "IPO_VITEST_B5|BLOCKED_MISSING_DEPENDENCIES"
 fi
else
 echo "IPO_VITEST_B5|BLOCKED_NO_PNPM"
fi
git diff --check
echo "DIFF_CHECK|PASS"
